decisions.statement: The count sits beside the account's page, so every process counts against one.
A slot is taken before a call is made rather than after.
A slot taken is spent whether the call answered or threw.
A call made once the window is older than its length opens a new window.
A taker beyond what the window holds is told how long that window has left.
A taker held off by a ban is told the ban rather than the window.
No call is made while the lock over the count is held.
The account a call is counted against is asked of the index rather than spelled.

definition: the calls one window holds, counted against the account every process shares
